description: This file defines the LogNode interface for a logging system in an Android application. It outlines the contract for log handlers, including a method for outputting log messages with various details and optional exception information.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface for a logging node that can output log messages and optionally pass them along a chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message, specifying its priority, tag, message, and optional exception.
